description:
When argument is [[Object]], the command returns the name given to a unit using the [[setIdentity]] instruction or selected randomly by the game engine if [[setIdentity]] has not been used on the unit.
If used on vehicle, name of first crew member (in order commander, driver, gunner). If used on an object, "Error: No unit" is being returned.
examples:
<sqf>
name nearestLocation [position player, "Hill"]; // ""
text nearestLocation [position player, "Hill"]; // "Lesnoy Khrebet"
</sqf>
name: name
problem_notes: {{Feature|important|If the provided unit is dead and has been removed from its group, its identity has then been purged to save memory and using [[name]] on it will result in a logged error.}}

ret.desc: the location's ''name''. To get its textual value, use [[text]] (see {{Link|#Example 3}})

namespace's ''name''. Possible values:
* "mission" - for [[missionNamespace]]
* "profile" - for [[profileNamespace]]
* "ui" - for [[uiNamespace]]
* "parsing" - for [[parsingNamespace]]
* "local" - for [[localNamespace]]
* "missionprofile" - for [[missionProfileNamespace]]
* "server" - for [[serverNamespace]]
* "" - for some unnamed namespaces like temporary or server config for example.
* "null" - null namespace (this should never happen)
The name given to the script via [[scriptName]] or the name passed to [[spawn]] when creating a [[Script_Handle#Promise_Handles|"Empty Handle"]]
